title: How Fast Companies Actually Respond
subtitle: Share of companies hitting each response benchmark
description: Lollipop chart showing how fast companies actually respond to leads. Only 7% of companies respond within 5 minutes, 37% respond within 1 hour, and 55% do not respond within 5 business days. Source: Drift Lead Response Survey (2017) and Harvard Business Review The Short Life of Online Sales Leads, 2011.
